evals.name: arm64-musl-native-installer
evals.prompt: This Alpine Dockerfile downloads pnpm-linux-${ARCH}-musl.tar.gz after mapping x86_64 to x64 and aarch64 to arm64. The image builds for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, but pnpm segfaults on arm64. Fix the Dockerfile and tell me what CI should verify.
evals.expected_output: Treats linux/arm64 plus musl as a runtime contract, avoids host-architecture detection, prefers a supported platform-neutral pnpm installation through npm when compatible, and requires pnpm execution in native amd64 and arm64 smoke tests rather than accepting a successful download or build.

assertions.name: models_libc_contract
assertions.check: Treats libc or ABI as part of the platform contract, not only the CPU architecture

assertions.name: rejects_host_detection
assertions.check: Does not use uname or the build host architecture to select the target artifact

assertions.name: prefers_supported_install
assertions.check: Prefers npm or another supported platform-neutral pnpm installation path when it meets the version requirement

assertions.name: tests_each_platform
assertions.check: Requires pnpm to execute successfully in runtime smoke tests on both amd64 and arm64

evals.name: hardcoded-goarch-in-multiarch-build
evals.prompt: Review this image before we publish it with docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64: `FROM golang:1.24-alpine AS build` followed by `RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -o /service ./cmd/service`, then the binary is copied into Alpine. Make the necessary changes and define validation.
evals.expected_output: Replaces the hardcoded architecture with an explicit cross-compilation or target-native build strategy, uses BUILDPLATFORM and TARGETOS or TARGETARCH correctly, preserves dependency cache ordering, and requires runtime execution for both manifest platforms.

assertions.name: removes_hardcoded_arch
assertions.check: Removes GOARCH=amd64 from a build that publishes arm64

assertions.name: chooses_valid_strategy
assertions.check: Uses a valid cross-compilation strategy with BUILDPLATFORM and target arguments, or explains why target-native builders are required

assertions.name: checks_native_dependencies
assertions.check: Checks whether CGO, native build hooks, or linked libraries invalidate simple cross-compilation

assertions.name: validates_manifest_and_runtime
assertions.check: Builds, executes, and verifies the manifest for both amd64 and arm64

evals.name: generated-dockerfile-source-ownership
evals.prompt: Fix an architecture-specific tool download in infrastructure/build/Dockerfile. The file header says it is autogenerated by a SparkFabrik package and infrastructure/build/Dockerfile.twig exists in the package source. The current download is linux_amd64 with one checksum, while CI publishes amd64 and arm64.
evals.expected_output: Reads project ownership instructions, refuses to make the persistent change only in the generated Dockerfile, changes or proposes the package template source, maps target architecture and checksums explicitly, and validates both published platforms after regeneration.

assertions.name: detects_generated_file
assertions.check: Recognizes the Dockerfile as generated and not the persistent source of truth

assertions.name: targets_template_source
assertions.check: Targets the package Dockerfile.twig or generator instead of editing only the generated consumer file

assertions.name: uses_per_target_integrity
assertions.check: Maps amd64 and arm64 artifact names with a checksum or signature for each target

assertions.name: regenerates_with_policy
assertions.check: Uses the project package workflow and required approval before regeneration
